origin.description: Return the current default locale name.
origin.example: old <- stri_locale_get(); stri_locale_set("pl_PL"); cat(paste0("stri_locale_get() returns ", stri_locale_get(), ".\n")); stri_locale_set(old)

translation.description: Return the current default locale name.
translation.example:
previous = stri_locale_get()
stri_locale_set("pl_PL")
print(f"stri_locale_get() returns {stri_locale_get()}.")
stri_locale_set(previous)
